content: Melvin-Koushki's footnote says Nafsat I extends the equivalency to say that all Sufis are Sunnis by necessity, but that as a lettrist Ibn Turka necessarily holds the Quran uncreated and was thus very much at odds with the Muʿtazila on that point.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I, pp.174-5 (per MK fn.155)
